probe_claims: The collapse of the Greenland Ice Sheet could trigger massive sea level rise.
Amazon rainforest dieback may transform the region from a carbon sink to a carbon source.
Disruption of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation could alter global climate patterns.
Thawing permafrost may release large quantities of methane, a potent greenhouse gas.
Loss of Arctic sea ice could accelerate regional and global warming.
Degradation of coral reefs may reduce marine biodiversity and affect oceanic carbon cycles.
Weakening of the West Antarctic Ice Sheet could lead to significant increases in sea levels.
Boreal forest dieback might result in the release of significant carbon stores.
Melting Himalayan glaciers threaten water supply for millions in Asia.
Ocean acidification could disrupt marine ecosystems and food security.
